Subject: Post-call recap + recommended models + perf digest

Hi Elaine — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we keep momentum: 

Call highlights:
- Primary goal: accurate clinical-notes summarization with strict PI redaction and 95th pct latency < 120ms for QPS ~200.
- Peak pattern: steady QPS during business hours, occasional bursts (5–10s) during clinic syncs.
- Data: customer-provided prompt set (~2k examples) and 3 representative long-note templates.

Redwood short recommendations (first pass):
1) Model shortlist (fast -> accurate):
   - redwood-vicuna-13b-q4f16: best cost/throughput tradeoff for conversational summarization (recommended pilot).
   - llama2-13b-chat-quant: slightly higher quality on rare clinical jargon; expect ~20% higher latency.
   - redwood-7b-instruct-quant: lowest cost, good for initial denoising/classification tasks.

2) Performance snapshot (we ran a targeted benchmark against your prompt set subset):
   - redwood-vicuna-13b-q4f16: throughput 210 TPS sustained (seq_len 512), median latency 48ms, p95 118ms.
   - llama2-13b-chat-quant: throughput 160 TPS, median 62ms, p95 165ms.
   - redwood-7b-instruct-quant: throughput 330 TPS, median 36ms, p95 95ms.

3) Quality/regression notes:
- We flagged ~1.7% of examples where hallucination risk rises (abbreviations in discharge notes). We recommend a small eval pass focused on those prompts (we'll share an "edge prompt" pack).
- If you plan to quantize further or run mixed-precision, we'll re-run the edge set to check for regressions.

Attachments & links:
- redwood_tps_profile_ora_v1.pdf (attached) — full throughput/latency percentiles and sampling details.
- prompt-set-ora.csv (attached) — sanitized subset we used for the run (200 examples).
- Bench run: https://drive.redwood.ai/ora-health/benchmarks/20260630/run-4512
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ORA-4512

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm whether the pilot target is 95th pct latency goal (120ms) or a different SLO.
- We: schedule a 60-min pilot kickoff (model selection + canary rollout plan).
- Joint: agree on an "edge prompt" pack for pre/post-deploy quality checks.

I can get a small pilot config (1-week smoke) spun up by next Tue if that timing works.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
